name: jobcardwise_scrap
title: Job Cardwise Scrap % Report
description: Job cardwise scrap % report from VIEW_JOB_CARD_SCRAP_PBI - exact logic of 'Job_Cardwise_Scrap_Generator_v4.html'. Use for: '/jobcardwise-scrap%-report', 'jobcardwise report', 'job card wise scrap', 'job card scrap %', 'peeling / piercing / pilger scrap', 'bucket report'. NOT for the plant-wise 'Scrap MIS' report (that is /scrap_mis_report).
rules:
SOURCE
1. Data: VIEW_JOB_CARD_SCRAP_PBI only. Rows whose Process Name contains 'MACHINING' are excluded.
2. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='jobcardwise_scrap', ...). Never write SQL for this report - the engine is an exact port of the v4 HTML tool and finds the view's columns itself. If it says 'Column(s) not found', show the user which ones.

PERIOD & UNIT
3. Month names ('Sep', 'last month', 'is mahine'), ranges or days. Month without year = latest past occurrence; current month = month to date. Nothing given -> current month to date.
4. Unit Kg by default (like the tool); 'MT' / 'ton' -> unit mt.
5. One section only when the user names it: 'peeling', 'black bar', 'bright bar' -> bb2bb; 'piercing', 'hollow', 'mother hollow' -> bb2hollow; 'pilger', 'sinking', 'seamless', 'final cutting' -> cutting.

LOGIC (built into the engine - explain if asked)
6. Process names cleaned like the tool (text after '-', aliases MH CUTTING -> MOTHER HOLLOW CUTTING, RB CUTTING -> ROUND BAR CUTTING, PILGERING -> PILGER, CUTTING & DEBURRING -> FINAL CUTTING & DEBURRING, PEEL*, PIERC*, SINK*).
7. Sections, one row per Job Card No (a job card on 2 plants is split per plant):
   A. Black Bar -> Bright Bar: Peeling + Round Bar Cutting, all plants. Buckets Above 10% | 8-10% | 5-8% | 3-5% | Upto 3%.
   B. Bright Bar -> Hollow: Piercing + Mother Hollow Cutting + Final Inspection (BA plant excluded on Final Inspection); only job cards with Item Group Mother Hollow. Buckets Above 10% | 5-10% | 3-5% | Upto 3%.
   C. Hollow -> Seamless: Pilger + Sinking + Final Cutting & Deburring; plants BA, Seamless Pipe-1/2, Seamless Tube. Buckets Above 20% | 15-20% | 10-15% | 5-10% | 3-5% | Upto 3%.
8. Per job card: Scrap = SUM(Scrap Qty) over its processes; Prod = MAX(Prod Qty with Scrap) over its processes; Scrap % = Scrap / Prod x 100. Plant of a job = plant of its highest-production row.
9. KPIs: Job cards in view (distinct job cards), Production qty and Scrap qty = sum of the three sections, Overall scrap % = Scrap / Production. Lower scrap = better.
output_format:
Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers by itself: KPI cards (Job cards, Production, Scrap, Overall scrap % and each section's scrap %, with ▲▼ vs previous month), chat tables (bucket summary + chart, plant-wise, 10 worst job cards per section) and the company's own HTML tool with this period's data already uploaded (all tabs, filters, Kg/MT toggle and its own Excel / PDF / Executive downloads work).
FORMATS: default [table, chart, dashboard]. Add 'excel' ONLY when the user asks for Excel (formatted Excel with every section and the full job-card lists); 'pdf' when asked; 'data' when they want the raw export.

SUMMARY in the user's language, 4-6 short lines:
- Overall scrap % (change vs previous month in pts), production and scrap qty.
- Scrap % of each section and its worst bucket count (e.g. '48 job cards above 20% in Hollow -> Seamless').
- The plant with the most scrap and the 3 worst job card numbers with their scrap %.
- Last line '✅ Checks passed' if every item in checks is ok, else '⚠️ ' + failed checks.
Mention: 'Open the 🖥️ dashboard for the full job-card detail.'
example_output: KPI cards: Job cards in view 883 | Production 42,18,143 Kg | Scrap 4,00,732 Kg | Overall scrap 9.50% ▲0.80 pts vs Sep | Black Bar → Bright Bar 4.12% | Bright Bar → Hollow 6.80% | Hollow → Seamless 14.30%. Then per section bucket table + chart, plant-wise table, 10 worst job cards, and the 🖥️ dashboard file.
